serving.notes: generation_config.json has no temperature, top_p, or max_new_tokens. Those three values are from the card's ask() example. config.json max_position_embeddings is 32768. The card also says "Best within 512 token context window". The API tokenizer_config includes a Mistral [INST] chat_template and use_default_system_prompt false. No adapter_config.json. The repository is three float16 shards (7,241,732,096 parameters) and the usage example loads AutoModelForCausalLM from this repo id, so the QLoRA update was merged into a full checkpoint. The Hub API still tags library_name peft and base_model:adapter. LoRA target modules on the card are q_proj, v_proj. Trainable params are stated as ~0.72% of total. GitHub link is the user profile https://github.com/MOHD-OMER; that profile's listed repositories do not include a training script for this model. The Space mohdomer/mistral-medical-qa-demo was sleeping when opened. No paper names this repository id.

evaluation_reported.text: Evaluation Results (50 held-out samples): ROUGE-1 27.00% base vs 29.45% fine-tuned; ROUGE-2 3.40% vs 5.29%; ROUGE-L 13.16% vs 16.37%; BLEU 1.28% vs 2.81%. The card says all metrics improve consistently after fine-tuning.
